scope: Static design and existing data/cache helper review only; no model construction, native fit, GPU, new candidate scores, or resource rerun.

resource_boundary.required: Committed complete full8 result, resource_execution_complete, cost_gate_passed, resource_qualification, exact source/environment/checkpoint, recomputed saved-array and native-count checks before dev-target parsing.
resource_boundary.counts: One native n_ensemble=8 fit per fold, eight generation samples/predictors/normal fine-tunes, one shared preprocessor and generator load; no eight separately fitted n1 substitutes.
resource_boundary.limits: Fresh sequential workers; 14400 seconds for each entire three-fold phase, process-tree RSS 10 GiB. Measured largest synthetic full8 is a planning reference, not a real-data convergence bound.
resource_boundary.cost: Largest full8 complete-case cost threshold 3840 seconds follows 3*1.25*elapsed<=14400. No further model-count extrapolation.

data_and_cache_review.dev_only: load_data checks original6954 development identity, raw attribute checksums and compact13 value proof; audit.read_development_only excludes other train labels. Whole-roster attributes are row-local, not learned preprocessing.
data_and_cache_review.random: random_references authenticates rawMitra/v44/v81 historic protocol/OOF evidence and original fold membership; historical lock files are not required to equal the new iLTM runtime.
data_and_cache_review.group: group_references authenticates stored fold arrays, dev/passenger/group IDs, matched references and per-fold logs; rejects group overlap and mismatched raw/v44 folds. Reuse exact saved indices, do not rebuild under new sklearn.
data_and_cache_review.worker_boundary: Implementation must pass only features.iloc[dev[train_positions]] and y[train_positions] to fit; validation attributes only for predict, no query labels or eval_set. Do not pass full features frame into native preprocessing.
data_and_cache_review.seed: Model seed20261117 is fixed in every fold; split seed20261112 is distinct. This is a recipe choice, not an additional independent split.

native_internal_validation: Generation/preprocessing sees eventual native internal holdout rows before internal split. That inner metric is not wholly unseen; honest outer isolation remains sufficient for the stated adaptive outer CV. No extra validation set should be passed.

gate_interpretation.challenge: These floors can admit a model weaker than current best. Passing both is practical-band exploratory eligibility only, not stable superiority, statistical equivalence, S status, or automatic export/upload.
gate_interpretation.accepted_response: Draft explicitly preserves separate phase results, reused-development disclosure, no S claim and a separate root decision after both complete phases.

implementation_review_requirements: Authenticate all prerequisite evidence and freeze transitive helper/source dependencies before targets; implementation/test approval remains outstanding.
Verify all eight native members completed without timeout, exact parameters before/after fit, original class order and finite normalized full validation predictions.
Publish pooled results only after three folds cover all6954 rows once; failure retains partial evidence but no complete eligibility or uploadable output.
Record actual epochs/updates and optionally a derived hit_epoch_cap flag per member. This is reporting, not a new gate or permission to extend budget.
Keep logloss and paired errors descriptive under the frozen gate; no post-outcome threshold, seed, blend or subgroup selection.

battle.peer_message_delivery: Direct author path unavailable; challenge relayed through root. Root supplied final frozen draft SHA for this review.

verification: Parsed and checked exact plan SHA, resource flags, seed separation, phase budgets and anchor arithmetic using stdlib only. No new candidate scores computed.
